evidenceSummary: The prior guard record confirms successful publication of 7f5f679. The failed candidate received HTTP 413 in completeAppDeployment, which the audited Wix CLI awaits before creating a preview and promoting production. Its run is terminal cancelled and its guard record is error. Ordinary and cache-busted public index bytes exactly match the prior Git commit, while two new candidate routes return 404. These observations support reconciling to the previous confirmed live SHA; they do not independently prove provider production topology or the complete live source commit.

failureEvidence.ordering: completeAppDeployment -> preview creation -> onPreviewCreated -> releaseHeadlessProject -> production topology update

proofLimits: Public observations cover the checked resources, edge and time only; they do not prove every origin, backend, cache, secret or full source commit.
No independent Wix production-topology attestation was obtained. Pre-promotion failure is supported by HTTP rejection and audited CLI ordering.
The CSS comparison uses an older available local build at 085bbdb, not an exact retained 7f5f679 binary build; it is supporting evidence only.
The companion asset is unchanged between releases and therefore does not distinguish the failed candidate.
This evidence records observations, not Noam's approval. A separate explicit approval of the exact dry-run plan is required before write mode.
